# `vox-orchestrator-mcp`

**Crate:** `vox-orchestrator-mcp` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool layer for vox-orchestrator. Extracted in 2026-05-08 reorg Phase 4.

## Crate Overview

Unified tool registry and dispatcher for the Vox MCP server.

Extracted from `vox-orchestrator/src/mcp_tools/` in 2026-05-08 reorg Phase 4.
